scope: 14 geometric development rooms and one existing controlled real room

central_seed1.scope: Truth-contact-valid counterfactual placement; not a measured route
central_seed1.threshold_note: Requires all 14 rooms eligible, >=80% point success and two later tested passes; not raw IMU

seed1.scope: Continuous bed-only model: three ideal geometric contacts span both axes; no raw IMU/walk route claim
seed1.threshold_protocol: At least 80% of 14 rooms meet the conditional radius target; two subsequent tested fractions pass
assumptions: Exact room and bed dimensions; axis-aligned bed with either orientation
Correct bed labels and phone-in-bed observations bounded by padding
Proposed point is continuous-envelope midpoint, not the existing joint-layout output

seed2.scope: Continuous bed-only model: three ideal geometric contacts span both axes; no raw IMU/walk route claim
seed2.threshold_protocol: At least 80% of 14 rooms meet the conditional radius target; two subsequent tested fractions pass
assumptions: Exact room and bed dimensions; axis-aligned bed with either orientation
Correct bed labels and phone-in-bed observations bounded by padding
Proposed point is continuous-envelope midpoint, not the existing joint-layout output

radius_audit.condition: True centre belongs to the reported centre envelope; not runtime verified

interpretation.A-U: Spatialised interactions: labels and positions, not labels alone
interpretation.K: Leave-target-out class-position density; no true wall identity
interpretation.coverage: Union of radius-0.25m discs around the observed route; starting point counts at zero distance
interpretation.abstention: Actual-output farthest-envelope radius <=0.5m; conditional on true centre in envelope

semantics.scope: Geometric oracle development; same path and anchor positions, class correspondence changed
semantics.A: Spatialised interactions with class and position; includes localisation evidence
semantics.control: Two fixed-point-free class cycles; event count/positions fixed, per-class counts can permute

desk.oracle_bearing_scope: Reference direction to true desk centre, not observed body facing; diagnostic side information only

real.reference_scope: Mixed provided references; chair provenance includes anchor/user confirmation, not independent scanned truth

limitations: Conditional envelope radius does not verify truth inclusion at runtime
A carries spatial coordinates and localisation information; it is not action labels alone
K is leave-room-out position density, not true wall identity or room-type revelation
Oracle direction is a bearing to the true desk centre, stronger than observed body facing
Counterfactual span scans do not establish an achievable natural-activity or raw-IMU threshold
No new real room, new sensor, model retraining or raw-IMU simulation validation in this audit
